# Phase 24 Look diversity -- real run (auto-generated by Phase24LookDiversityRealRunTests)

Real layout: `C:\xLights\xlights_rgbeffects.xml`. Choreographer model: `qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct` via local Ollama.
Real song: `Dubstep Christmas Light Show.mp3` (30s clip), real bar count 18, reshaped into
5 synthetic Chorus-kind sections (real clip's own natural structure does not
repeat any one Kind 5+ times, so this is the one input this phase's own
measurement needed that the real analysis alone does not provide).

## §2a: real validator rejection
Baseline Show Bible (1 Look eligible for Chorus, the shape every Show Bible before this phase could
legally have): `REJECTED`
-- SectionKind 'Chorus' occurs 5 times in this song, but only 1 Look(s) are eligible for it (AllowedSectionKinds names 'Chorus', or is left unrestricted) -- need at least 3 (ceil(5/2)) distinct eligible Looks so repeats of this Kind are not forced to reuse the same one or two Looks.
Diverse Show Bible (3 Looks eligible for Chorus, meeting ceil(5/2)=3): `accepted`

## §2b: real Director prompt excerpt
```
Chorus repeats 5 times: bars [0,3), [3,6), [6,9), [9,12), [12,18) (note: the last one is 6 bars, longer than the others) -- design at least 3 visibly distinct Looks across these 5 occurrences, not one Look reused. At least 3 Looks must stay eligible for Chorus (AllowedSectionKinds names 'Chorus', or is left unrestricted) or this Show Bible will fail validation -- see the REQUIRED rule above.
```

## §2d: real measured Look/effect diversity across the Chorus sections, before vs after
| Bible | Distinct LookIds used across 5 Chorus sections | Distinct xLights effect names compiled across those sections |
|---|---:|---:|
| Baseline (1 eligible Look) | 2 | 6 |
| Diverse (ceil(5/2)=3 eligible Looks) | 5 | 6 |

Real section-by-section LookId assignment (baseline): look-9, look-0, look-9, look-0, look-9
Real section-by-section LookId assignment (diverse): look-1, look-3, look-8, look-2, look-9

**Disclosed finding, measured directly by this real run, not assumed:** a Look's own
`AllowedSectionKinds` is advisory to the real Choreographer call, not a hard filter --
`SectionScriptPromptBuilder` lists every Look (not just the eligible ones) with a `sections=`
annotation, and neither `SectionScriptValidator` nor `SectionScriptCompiler` ever rejects a
SectionScript whose `LookId` ignores it. The baseline run above measured
2 distinct Looks used even though only 1 was declared
eligible for Chorus -- the real local 7B Choreographer model did not reliably honor the
restriction. §2a's validator floor and §2b's repeat-structure prompt line (both verified above)
are real and working as designed; they raise how many Looks a repeating Kind COULD legitimately
draw from, and tell the Director to design that many -- but neither one, nor anything else in
this codebase yet, forces the Choreographer's own per-section pick to respect that ceiling at
generation time. Closing that remaining gap (a real per-section eligibility check, enforced the
same way `look-ref` already is) is follow-up work this measurement surfaces, not something §2a/
§2b themselves claimed to solve.
